title: com.reconcile arguments (fabric-project-comms/0.1, DEC-0073)
description: outcome_unknown to completed or failed_known, observed only. Estate, caller Project, principal and session come from the authenticated endpoint and are never accepted here: an unknown field is refused (invalid_arguments).

request.description: A request of the caller's Project in outcome_unknown, for a capability whose current slot the caller holds.

digest.description: The request's semantic digest; another one is digest_conflict.

observed.description: Reconciliation settles an unknown outcome only by an observed result.
